title: Identification and characterization of a small molecule BFstatin inhibiting BrpR, the transcriptional regulator for biofilm formation of Vibrio vulnificus.
authors: Lee, Hojun; Hwang, Seung-Ho; Shin, Hyunwoo; Ha, Nam-Chul; Wang, Qiyao; Choi, Sang Ho
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过筛选小分子BFstatin抑制转录调控因子BrpR与靶DNA结合，并辅以分子动力学模拟解析其作用机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作调控研究，但核心为药物抑制而非TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Many pathogenic bacteria form biofilms that are resistant to not only host immune defenses but also antibiotics, posing a need for the development of strategies to control biofilms. In this study, to prevent biofilm formation of the fulminating foodborne pathogen Vibrio vulnificus, chemical libraries were extensively screened to identify a small molecule inhibiting the activity of BrpR, a transcriptional regulator for biofilm genes. Accordingly, the BrpR inhibitor BFstatin [N1-(2-chloro-5-fluorophenyl)-N3-propylmalonamide], with a half-maximal effective concentration of 8.01 muM, was identified. BFstatin did not interfere with bacterial growth or exhibit cytotoxicity to the human epithelial cell line. BFstatin directly bound to BrpR and interrupted its binding to the target promoter DNAs of the downstream genes. Molecular dynamics simulation of the interaction between BFstatin and BrpR proposed that BFstatin modifies the structure of BrpR, especially the DNA-binding domain. Transcriptomic analyses revealed that BFstatin reduces the expression of the BrpR regulon including the cabABC operon and brp locus which contribute to the production of biofilm matrix of V. vulnificus. Accordingly, BFstatin diminished the biofilm levels of V. vulnificus by inhibiting the matrix development in a concentration-dependent manner. Altogether, BFstatin could be an anti-biofilm agent targeting BrpR, thereby rendering V. vulnificus more susceptible to host immune defenses and antibiotics.
abstract_zh: 许多致病菌形成的生物膜不仅抵抗宿主免疫防御，还抵抗抗生素，这促使了控制生物膜策略的开发需求。本研究旨在预防暴发性食源性病原体创伤弧菌（Vibrio vulnificus）的生物膜形成，通过广泛筛选化学文库，鉴定出一种抑制BrpR（生物膜基因的转录调控因子）活性的小分子。据此，鉴定出BrpR抑制剂BFstatin [N1-(2-氯-5-氟苯基)-N3-丙基丙二酰胺]，其半数有效浓度为8.01 μM。BFstatin不干扰细菌生长，对人上皮细胞系无细胞毒性。BFstatin直接结合BrpR，并中断其与下游基因靶启动子DNA的结合。分子动力学模拟BFstatin与BrpR的相互作用表明，BFstatin修饰了BrpR的结构，尤其是DNA结合域。转录组分析揭示，BFstatin降低了BrpR调控子的表达，包括cabABC操纵子和brp位点，这些均有助于创伤弧菌生物膜基质的产生。因此，BFstatin通过浓度依赖性方式抑制基质发育，减少了创伤弧菌的生物膜水平。总之，BFstatin可作为靶向BrpR的抗生物膜剂，从而使创伤弧菌更易受宿主免疫防御和抗生素的影响。
